column2: a heavy linked belt of 100 large-calibre assault cannon rounds, brass casings and steel links, coiled in a short loop
a pack of ten taser darts: barbed electrode darts with trailing fine copper wires, bright yellow plastic cartridges
a lavish penthouse suite: marble, a glass wall over a city at dusk, a grand piano and a pool, seen as a small vignette
a high-rise luxury condo living room: designer sofa, big trideo screen, tall windows with a skyline, warm lamps
a tidy middle-class arcology apartment: compact kitchen, couch, potted plant, a small window with daylight
a cramped rented room in a bad neighbourhood: stained mattress, hot plate, peeling wallpaper, a single bare bulb
a squatter's corner of a condemned building: cardboard, a sleeping bag, candles, graffiti on crumbling concrete
life on the street: a shopping cart of belongings, a trash-can fire and a tarp shelter under an overpass, rain
a hermetic magician's tools: an open grimoire of glowing diagrams, a ritual dagger and a chalk circle, cool teal light
a hermetic sorcerer's focus: a crystal orb crackling with arcane energy above a page of formulae, white-gold light
a hermetic conjurer's summoning: a silver-inked binding circle with a faint elemental shape rising from it, amber light
a shaman's medicine bag and totem: a carved animal-totem pole, feathers, bones and a drum, firelit
a shamanic sorcerer's rattle and painted gourd glowing with spirit light, sage smoke curling around it
a nature spirit taking shape from wind and leaves above a shaman's offering bowl, green and earthy light
a physical adept's wrapped fists and a training dummy, a faint aura of focused power around the hands, red-orange light
a shamanic adept's warrior band: a feathered armband and a bone-handled knife, faint animal-spirit glow, earthy tones
